711:         X : array-like of shape (n_ts, sz, d)
712:             Time series dataset
713: 
714:         Returns
715:         -------
716:         numpy.ndarray of integers with shape (n_ts, n_segments, 2 * d)
717:             1d-SAX-Transformed dataset
718:         """
719:         self._is_fitted()
720:         X = check_array(X, allow_nd=True, dtype=float,
721:                         force_all_finite=False)
722:         X = check_dims(X, X_fit_dims=tuple(self._X_fit_dims_),
723:                        check_n_features_only=True)
724:         return self._transform(X, y)
725: 
726:     def distance_1d_sax(self, sax1, sax2):
727:         """Compute distance between 1d-SAX representations as defined in [1]_.
728: 
729:         Parameters
730:         ----------
731:         sax1 : array-like
732:             1d-SAX representation of a time series
733:         sax2 : array-like
734:             1d-SAX representation of another time series
735: 
736:         Returns
737:         -------
738:         float
739:             1d-SAX distance
740: 
741:         Notes
742:         -----
743:             Unlike SAX distance, 1d-SAX distance does not lower bound Euclidean
744:             distance between original time series.
745: 
746:         References
747:         ----------
748:         .. [1] S. Malinowski, T. Guyet, R. Quiniou, R. Tavenard. 1d-SAX: a
749:            Novel Symbolic Representation for Time Series. IDA 2013.
750:         """
751:         self._is_fitted()
752:         return cydist_1d_sax(sax1, sax2, self.breakpoints_avg_middle_,
753:                              self.breakpoints_slope_middle_,
754:                              self._X_fit_dims_[1])
755: 
756:     def distance(self, ts1, ts2):
757:         """Compute distance between 1d-SAX representations as defined in [1]_.
758: 
759:         Parameters
760:         ----------
761:         ts1 : array-like
762:             A time series
763:         ts2 : array-like
764:             Another time series
765: 
766:         Returns
767:         -------
768:         float
769:             1d-SAX distance
770: 
771:         References
772:         ----------
773:         .. [1] S. Malinowski, T. Guyet, R. Quiniou, R. Tavenard. 1d-SAX: a
774:            Novel Symbolic Representation for Time Series. IDA 2013.
775:         """
776:         sax1d = self.transform([ts1, ts2])
777:         return self.distance_1d_sax(sax1d[0], sax1d[1])
778: 
779:     def inverse_transform(self, X):
780:         """Compute time series corresponding to given 1d-SAX representations.
781: 
782:         Parameters
783:         ----------
784:         X : array-like of shape (n_ts, sz_sax, 2 * d)
785:             A dataset of SAX series.
786: 
787:         Returns
788:         -------
789:         numpy.ndarray of shape (n_ts, sz_original_ts, d)
790:             A dataset of time series corresponding to the provided
791:             representation.
792:         """
793:         self._is_fitted()
794:         X = check_array(X, allow_nd=True)
795:         X = check_dims(X, X_fit_dims=(None, None, 2 * self._X_fit_dims_[-1]),
796:                        check_n_features_only=True)
797:         X_orig = inv_transform_1d_sax(
798:                 X,
799:                 breakpoints_avg_middle_=self.breakpoints_avg_middle_,
800:                 breakpoints_slope_middle_=self.breakpoints_slope_middle_,
801:                 original_size=self._X_fit_dims_[1]
802:         )
803:         return self._unscale(X_orig)
804: 
805:     def _more_tags(self):
806:         tags = super()._more_tags()
807:         tags['_xfail_checks'].update({
808:             "check_transformer_preserve_dtypes" : "Forces int transform"
809:         })
810:         return tags
811: 
812:     def __sklearn_tags__(self):
813:         # Needed for check_estimator_tags_renamed
814:         return super().__sklearn_tags__()
